L249: ## Welcome to Our Town
L250: 
L251: Southampton is a small, rural town of approximately 6,200 people in Western Massachusetts. Located in Hampshire County, just west of the Connecticut River Valley, Southampton is about 100 miles west of Boston, and 150 miles north of New York City. Established in 1775 as a farming community, Southampton’s historically rural character is still intact. Residents value the town’s agricultural heritage, its scenic areas and hiking trails.
